subject: Mid-quarter leadership snapshot: priority slices & QBR readiness
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Mid-quarter leadership snapshot: priority slices & QBR readiness

Team —

Attached is a short leadership snapshot for mid-quarter. High-level summary first, then asks. PDF attached: 07-23_leadership_snapshot.pdf (2 pages).

Quick summary:
- OKR A (Serving runtime perf): on track for baseline latency target, but behind on the low-p99 tail improvements (currently 0.9% behind target).
- OKR B (Dedicated capacity adoption): adoption is flattening; need a small re-scope to shift focus from broad marketing pilots to two anchor customers.
- OKR C (Private deployments compliance): on schedule, but SOC evidence collection is blocking audit prep for one enterprise.

Proposed immediate actions (please reply with owner + ETA by Friday EOD PST):
1) Re-scope OKR B to focus on two anchor accounts (ACME + Partner Platform) and remove broad pilot metric. Owner: lauren_bishop suggested. ETA request: proposed decision 2026-07-28.
2) Low-p99 tail work: allocate 2 FTE (infra/runtime) for 6 weeks to address kernel-selection regressions; need infra confirmation on capacity/time. Owner: naomi_feldman.
3) SOC evidence: collect retention and access logs for Private deployments for the affected account. Owner: vanessa_ortiz; if we can't get logs by 07-30 we request a temporary QBR note for the customer.

Dependencies called out in the attached snapshot: infra queue, contract team review for anchor customers, and a small DocuSign tweak for dedicated terms. I pasted the short dependency matrix below for visibility.

Dependency matrix (short):
- infra: kernel patch + testing window -> ETA needed (naomi)
- commercial: sign-off on anchor pilot scope and discount tiers -> lauren
- security/compliance: log bundle + attestation -> vanessa

Requests: please reply with a one-line confirmation of ownership and a concrete ETA (date). If you need me to reassign, say so.

Link to working doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/QBR-2026/leadership-snapshot

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership snapshot: priority slices & QBR readiness

Michael — thanks for the concise snapshot and matrix. I support re-scoping OKR B to two anchor customers (ACME + Partner Platform). Quick notes:

- I'll own the commercial re-scope. ETA: decision and updated success criteria by 2026-07-28 COB. I'll attach a small capacity_rebalance_v1.xlsx with proposed reallocation across GTM resources.
- I do want a small follow-up with CS to confirm no open commitments that rely on the previous broader pilot definition — tentatively scheduled Fri 07/24 11:00am PT; CC'ing stephanie in case CS needs to join.

Attachment: capacity_rebalance_v1.xlsx

On the DocuSign term tweak, legal is OK with a 30-day limited pilot amendment; we just need procurement to sign. I'll follow up with procurement today and loop the Partner Platform contact.

- lauren

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 08:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership snapshot: priority slices & QBR readiness

Michael / Lauren —

I can take the infra ownership for the low-p99 tail but need to be explicit about the blocker: the kernel-selection work requires a dedicated test window on our GPU cluster and a coordinated canary (approx 48–72 hours) to validate perf at scale. Current infra backlog puts earliest available window at 2026-08-10 unless we re-prioritize.

Options:
- Option A: We reassign two runtime engineers now and take a small risk bump; can start validation week of 2026-07-27 but will require overtime/testing support from infra ops.
- Option B: Accept the 08-10 window and set a mitigation note in the QBR (explain risk and expected impact).

If Lauren is committing resource reallocation in the next 48 hours (per the capacity file), I can run Option A and commit to a first validation run by 2026-08-03. If not, we'll go with Option B.

Attachment: infra_impact_matrix.csv

- naomi

Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership snapshot: priority slices & QBR readiness

Team —

I can take SOC evidence collection for the Private deployments, but two notes:
1) We only have 7 days of raw access logs retained by default for the affected environment; to meet the auditor ask we might need a short-term retention increase (legal + infra approval). I will open the retention ticket today and tag legal.
2) For the anchor pilot promise to ACME, we should confirm whether a temporary SLA note is acceptable in the QBR instead of full audit completion. If Lauren can confirm commercial terms and timeline, I'll prioritize the log bundle collection to be completed by 2026-07-30.

I approve reallocation on paper for one week as a contingency (if Lauren confirms no customer-facing regressions). Otherwise, we should highlight the risk in the QBR.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
